evidence_scope: small-system numerical research, not hardware execution

hypotheses.evidence: Path circuits need no SWAP routing, but no same-algorithm routing ablation isolates the source of the benefit.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: Path circuits need no SWAP routing, but no same-algorithm routing ablation isolates the source of the benefit.
hypotheses.counterexamples_or_limits: Routing, decomposition and state-specific gate elimination are confounded in total cost differences.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Measure explicit SWAP and controlled-distribution costs with the same topology/compiler.
hypotheses.falsifier: Optimized candidates lose their cost advantage under equally optimized routing.

hypotheses.evidence: Proven for open chains; exact D₂⁴ bound verified independently. Star is a counterexample to extending the chain claim to all graphs.
hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: Complete derivation in theory.md: Plucker obstruction and exact D2^4 Slater bound.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: Proven for open chains; exact D₂⁴ bound verified independently. Star is a counterexample to extending the chain claim to all graphs.
hypotheses.counterexamples_or_limits: The star prepares D2^4 with XY+Z alone; the chain theorem is not graph-general.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Joint-sector star leaf test; distinguish ring parity from branched connectivity.
hypotheses.falsifier: An independently verified open-chain quadratic circuit violates the Plucker bound (would contradict the assumptions or implementation).

hypotheses.evidence: One CP achieves unit numerical fidelity for D₂⁴ and D₃⁶ at sufficient tested depth; four-layer D₂⁴ is a negative result.
hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: CP introduces nonquadratic fermion interactions; no general sufficiency theorem.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: One CP achieves unit numerical fidelity for D₂⁴ and D₃⁶ at sufficient tested depth; four-layer D₂⁴ is a negative result.
hypotheses.counterexamples_or_limits: Four-layer one-CP D2^4 trial did not improve fidelity; zero-CP star single-sector success does not imply all-sector success.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Require common-sector phase coherence before generalizing.
hypotheses.falsifier: Additional intermediate states require interaction counts growing too rapidly to retain the cost advantage.

hypotheses.evidence: Arbitrary FSim compiled to CZ; no calibrated fixed-native comparison exists.
hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: Exchange and CP commute on the same pair and combine algebraically into FSim; pulse availability is a separate question.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: Arbitrary FSim compiled to CZ; no calibrated fixed-native comparison exists.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Obtain an actual processor gate-set record and fixed-pulse compiler.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fixed native pulse compilation is no cheaper than CZ at equal fidelity.

hypotheses.evidence: Collective symmetry can conserve target overlap and obstruct preparation; no fair constrained-parameter optimization measured.
hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: Permutation-symmetric target-eigenstate controls can conserve target overlap; symmetry is not automatically helpful.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: Collective symmetry can conserve target overlap and obstruct preparation; no fair constrained-parameter optimization measured.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Test input-compatible reflection constraints at equal budgets.
hypotheses.falsifier: Symmetry constraints reduce attainable fidelity or do not reduce wall time.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Short approximate beats deep exact under noise
hypotheses.evidence: Observed at n=6 for synthetic channel model after equal pruning/compilation, not calibrated hardware.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: Observed at n=6 for synthetic channel model after equal pruning/compilation, not calibrated hardware.
hypotheses.counterexamples_or_limits: At n=4 the deeper exact chain circuit beats the shorter approximate one at p2=.001; the ordering depends on noise and candidate.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Sweep T1/T2 and coherent parameter errors; reversal would limit this observation.
hypotheses.falsifier: The ordering reverses across measured/calibrated error ranges.

hypotheses.evidence: A common-phase, all-weight star leaf with one CP is numerically verified at 26 CZ versus the same-star routed SCS unitary at 250 CZ. Full recursive integration/scaling remains untested. Zero-CP trial fails the coherent leaf test within the bounded schedule.
hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: The binomial split and common-sector phase conditions are necessary for coherent substitution.
hypotheses.numerical_evidence: A common-phase, all-weight star leaf with one CP is numerically verified at 26 CZ versus the same-star routed SCS unitary at 250 CZ. Full recursive integration/scaling remains untested. Zero-CP trial fails the coherent leaf test within the bounded schedule.
hypotheses.counterexamples_or_limits: The zero-CP star trial fails common-sector preparation despite unit weight-two fidelity; no full recursive integration exists.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_experiment: Substitute the verified leaf into one physically mapped recursion node; compare full routed cost and branch coherence.
hypotheses.falsifier: A coherent multi-sector leaf is no cheaper than the existing exact unitary.
